comments.body_html: I’m not sure if you’re aware so it’s not your fault, but every time a new mod gets uploaded it notifies the SPT Discord’s #mod-releases section and pings everyone subscribed to it just so you know. A lot of people subscribe to that page to see new mods coming in, and they had to disable it temporarily due to the massive influx of these mods pouring in.
